item.title: Microsoft’s Copilot Super App: The Race to Consolidate AI
item.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has confirmed plans for a Copilot super app that will unite chat, coding, Cowork and autonomous AI agents, creating a single flagship experience spanning both Microsoft’s consumer and commercial AI offerings. The post Microsoft’s Copilot Super App: The Race to Consolidate AI appeared first on Cloud Wars .
